Q: Where can I get help if I'm struggling with my nursing assignment?

In case you’re finding It hard working on your nursing assignment, you can seek assistance through:

  • Tutors and/or your academic advisor in case of uncertainties regarding the assignment
  • University writing services or academic skills workshops
  • Library databases and tools for referencing
  • Through peer study groups involving collaborative work
